product: Sulfide-based solid electrolyte (LiPSCl argyrodite powder, Gen1-3) plus licensed cell designs and manufacturing processes. Solid Power sells electrolyte to cell makers and OEMs rather than competing as a cell maker (8-K 2026-08-04). Demand is for EV all-solid-state programs; the 2026-09-14 deck also cites robotics, defense, aviation and off-highway.
demand: Neither price nor volume: revenue is shrinking. Q2 2026 revenue and grant income minus $0.3M versus $7.5M in Q2 2025 (8-K 2026-08-04); FY2026 consensus revenue about $5.5M, down 69% (stockanalysis.com 2026-09-27). Any growth must come from later electrolyte volume at pilot pricing.
pricing_power: Gross margin is already negative: Q2 2026 direct costs $2.1M exceeded revenue, and a $1.2M revenue reversal pushed revenue to minus $0.3M (8-K 2026-08-04). If Li2S precursor costs, yields, or Korea JV pricing fail to fall with scale, cost per kg stays high and margins stay negative (8-K 2026-09-14).
competition: Chinese sulfide electrolyte and ASSB developers are the low-cost substitute, and China is scaling sulfide chemistry in a market the deck says is 50% sulfide-based. Solid Power counters with a wet process it claims retains 70-80% of lithium-ion equipment, a structural cost argument, not current proof (8-K 2026-09-14).
market_strategy: CEO John Van Scoter, 2026-08-04: continuous pilot line equipment acceptance testing targeted for Q3 2026, plant validation and operational startup planned Q4 2026, on track for $85-100M 2026 cash investment. The 2026-09-14 deck adds 75 MT/y by YE2026, a Korea JV by YE2026, and ISO 9001 by year-end.
bull: Dated primary 8-Ks show SK On milestone paid, ISO 9001 Stage 1 done, BMW VP on board, $419.3M cash and no debt, and reaffirmed 75 MT/y plus Korea JV by YE2026.
bear: Q2 2026 revenue was minus $0.3M on a $1.2M reversal; FY2026 consensus revenue down 69%; gross margin negative; Korea JV still only in discussions; shares rose to 227.2M.
falsifier: No Korea commercial-scale electrolyte JV announced by 2026-12-31, or the continuous pilot line misses Q4 2026 startup or the 75 MT/y target.
web_what_changed_30_90d: 2026-09-14 8-K Reg-FD investor deck reaffirmed 75 MT/y by YE2026 and a Korea JV by YE2026 (sec.gov, primary). 2026-08-04 8-K: Q2 2026 revenue and grant income minus $0.3M after a $1.2M reversal; liquidity $419.3M (primary). 2026-07-02 8-K: BMW VP Uwe Breitweg joined the board effective 2026-07-01 (primary).
web_true_now_not_modelled: Cash is large but the top line inverted: liquidity $419.3M at 2026-06-30, no debt, after a $121.3M-net registered direct offering in H1 2026, yet Q2 revenue and grant income was minus $0.3M and shares grew to 227.2M from 201.2M (8-K 2026-08-04). Analysts still carry $6.75-$7.00 targets (stockanalysis.com 2026-09-27).
web_demand_product: Sulfide-based solid electrolyte (LiPSCl argyrodite powder, Gen1-3) plus licensed cell designs and manufacturing processes. Solid Power sells electrolyte to cell makers and OEMs rather than competing as a cell maker (8-K 2026-08-04). Demand is for EV all-solid-state programs; the 2026-09-14 deck also cites robotics, defense, aviation and off-highway.
web_price_volume_mix: Neither price nor volume: revenue is shrinking. Q2 2026 revenue and grant income minus $0.3M versus $7.5M in Q2 2025 (8-K 2026-08-04); FY2026 consensus revenue about $5.5M, down 69% (stockanalysis.com 2026-09-27). Any growth must come from later electrolyte volume at pilot pricing.
web_bottleneck: Scale and partner capital. Pilot capacity is 30 MT/y versus a 75 MT/y target by YE2026, needing the continuous line, and a Korea JV for 500 MT. Timing risk is real: a $1.2M milestone assumption change cut Q2 revenue (8-K 2026-08-04 and 2026-09-14). It relieves ASSB electrolyte scarcity for cell makers.
web_who_benefits_next: BMW and SK On (licensees; BMW nominated a board member 2026-07-01), Samsung SDI (Joint Evaluation Agreement), and the unnamed Korean JV partner. Also lithium-ion equipment suppliers reused at 70-80% of roll-to-roll and Li2S precursor suppliers (8-K 2026-07-02 and 2026-09-14).
web_who_loses: Incumbent liquid-electrolyte and separator suppliers, and rival sulfide or oxide ASSB developers that would lose the electrolyte layer if Solid Power's sell-materials-not-cells model becomes the standard (inference from 8-K 2026-09-14). The previous card carried the same inference.
web_margin_collapse_risk: Gross margin is already negative: Q2 2026 direct costs $2.1M exceeded revenue, and a $1.2M revenue reversal pushed revenue to minus $0.3M (8-K 2026-08-04). If Li2S precursor costs, yields, or Korea JV pricing fail to fall with scale, cost per kg stays high and margins stay negative (8-K 2026-09-14).
web_low_cost_substitute: Chinese sulfide electrolyte and ASSB developers are the low-cost substitute, and China is scaling sulfide chemistry in a market the deck says is 50% sulfide-based. Solid Power counters with a wet process it claims retains 70-80% of lithium-ion equipment, a structural cost argument, not current proof (8-K 2026-09-14).
web_ceo_promised: CEO John Van Scoter, 2026-08-04: continuous pilot line equipment acceptance testing targeted for Q3 2026, plant validation and operational startup planned Q4 2026, on track for $85-100M 2026 cash investment. The 2026-09-14 deck adds 75 MT/y by YE2026, a Korea JV by YE2026, and ISO 9001 by year-end.
web_did_they_deliver: Mixed. 2026-05-05: completed SK On pilot cell site acceptance testing, the final milestone under the line installation agreement, and finished factory acceptance testing of continuous-line equipment. 2026-08-04: received the SK On milestone payment and finished ISO 9001 Stage 1. But revenue turned negative on a $1.2M reversal and the Korea JV was still only in discussions.
web_what_would_falsify: Observable break: no Korea commercial-scale electrolyte JV announced by 2026-12-31, or the continuous pilot line misses Q4 2026 startup or the 75 MT/y target, or FY2026 cash investment exceeds the $85-100M guide (8-K 2026-08-04 and 2026-09-14).
